events.text: The first frost silvers every blade of grass.

effects.log: Cold feet, clear mind.

choices.text: Stay under your blanket a little longer

effects.log: The warmest minute of the year.

events.text: Hungry wolves come down from the mountains after the frost.

ok.log: The pack scatters. The shepherds cheer.

fail.log: The wolves are bold. You come back bitten.

choices.text: Help build fires around the village

effects.log: The wolves circle, and stay away.

events.text: The cold wakes an old wound.

effects.log: The ache fades by noon.
Warmth spreads. Your control improves.

events.text: An old couple has no firewood for the winter.

effects.log: Three days of work. Two warm old people.
Warm and quick. (−6 taels)

events.text: A rare flower blooms only on the first frost. Physicians pay well for it.

ok.log: Under a pine, glittering with frost. (+15 taels)

effects.log: Someone else will find them. Or no one.

events.text: A traveller lies half-frozen by the road.

choices.text: Carry them to the nearest fire

effects.log: They live. They were a merchant, and they remember.
You shiver all the way home.

events.text: The markets are selling winter stores: salted fish, pickles, dried persimmons.

effects.log: A comfortable winter. (−5 taels)
A day of salt and gossip. You are given a jar.

events.text: A northern swordsman says fighters from warm places cannot fight in the cold. He challenges you.

ok.log: You win. Your breath steams; his pride melts.

choices.text: Invite him in for tea instead

effects.log: He laughs. You become friends.

events.text: You write your name in the frost on the window.

effects.log: A frost dragon, gone by noon.

choices.text: Breathe on it to watch it melt

effects.log: Your breath makes clouds. You are a dragon.

events.text: A frozen pond with something shining under the ice.

effects.log: Some treasures prefer to wait.

events.text: A monk sits meditating in the frost in only a thin robe, steam rising off him.

effects.log: 'Breathe as if the cold were a guest,' he says. You try.
He drinks it and says the tea was the lesson.

events.text: A tavern serves hot spiced tea on the first frost night.

effects.log: New friends by midnight.

choices.text: Drink tea alone by the window

effects.log: The frost on the glass looks like mountains.
